privacy.statement: Selected native inspect fields captured in a trusted disposable environment and consistently replaced. No real endpoint, host, user, credential, secret, environment value, container, image, path, or repository data is present; no full inspect response is committed.

provenance.capture_commands: CLI: local scratch build/tag then podman create only. Provider: Compose create with --pull never then native podman inspect. Neither capture establishes pull or build history.
